description: CommitBench style (chat only): write a commit message for a staged diff that mixes one behavioural change (Retry-After derived from the token bucket refill rate instead of a constant 60) with an unrelated import reorder and comment typo fix. The message must have an imperative subject naming the real behaviour, every line within 72 characters, no past-tense or prefixed subject, and no mention of the incidental edits.
